grammar_tips.title: Countable and uncountable nouns
grammar_tips.explanation: Some foods can be counted (e.g., apples, eggs), but some cannot (e.g., rice, water, bread). We say 'some bread' not 'a bread', but 'an apple' not 'some apple'.

explanation_translation.Hindi: कुछ खाद्य चीज़ें गिनी जा सकती हैं (जैसे, सेब, अंडे), लेकिन कुछ नहीं (जैसे, चावल, पानी, ब्रेड)। हम कहते हैं 'some bread', 'an apple'।
explanation_translation.Japanese: 数えられる名詞（りんご、卵）と、数えられない名詞（ご飯、水、パン）がある。

grammar_tips.title: Using 'like' and 'don't like' for food
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'I like' or 'I don't like' to talk about food and drinks you enjoy or not. Example: 'I like apples.' 'I don't like tea.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: अगर आपको कोई खाना या पेय पसंद है या नहीं है, तो 'I like' या 'I don't like' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: 'I like apples.' 'I don't like tea.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 食べ物や飲み物の好みを言う時は'I like'または'I don't like'を使います。例: 'I like apples.' 'I don't like tea.'
